animal_followups_outcome_state_check.name: animal_followups_outcome_state_check
animal_followups_outcome_state_check.value: ("animal_observation_followups"."status" = 'Completed' AND "animal_observation_followups"."outcome" IS NOT NULL AND "animal_observation_followups"."outcome_recorded_at" IS NOT NULL) OR ("animal_observation_followups"."status" IN ('Pending', 'Cancelled') AND "animal_observation_followups"."outcome" IS NULL)

clinical_orders_unknown_completion_check.name: clinical_orders_unknown_completion_check
clinical_orders_unknown_completion_check.value: NOT "clinical_orders"."completed_at_unknown" OR ("clinical_orders"."status" = 'Completed' AND "clinical_orders"."completed_at" IS NULL AND "clinical_orders"."administered_at_external_clinic" = true)

observations_row_locator_check.name: observations_row_locator_check
observations_row_locator_check.value: "migration"."observations"."source_row_id" IS NOT NULL OR "migration"."observations"."row_number" IS NOT NULL

patient_ext_imm_course_slot_uniq.name: patient_ext_imm_course_slot_uniq
patient_ext_imm_course_slot_uniq.where: "patient_external_immunizations"."patient_standing_order_id" IS NOT NULL AND "patient_external_immunizations"."service_id" IS NOT NULL AND "patient_external_immunizations"."dose_number_in_series" IS NOT NULL AND "patient_external_immunizations"."deleted_at" IS NULL

patient_ext_imm_date_presence_check.name: patient_ext_imm_date_presence_check
patient_ext_imm_date_presence_check.value: ("patient_external_immunizations"."administered_date_precision" = 'Unknown' AND "patient_external_immunizations"."administered_date" IS NULL) OR ("patient_external_immunizations"."administered_date_precision" IN ('Exact', 'Estimated') AND "patient_external_immunizations"."administered_date" IS NOT NULL)
